baseline: sequential climatology (Laplace running base rate, per domain per seed).
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, InstrumentedArchB (equivalence-proven in 0071), affect=none, 10 eps x 4 fresh seeds {73211,73212,73213,73214}, PredictionLog JSONL + sidecar JSONL per seed. 1560 ticks/domain. Estimator feature_mode='C' (causal prequential replay).

config.estimator: competence_estimator.CompetenceEstimator variant C feature_mode='C' (REST-channel features + ehat on rest for D1/D3), normalized SGD eta_p=0.1/eta_e=0.05

hypothesis: Channel-decomposed REST error features (excluding the pure-RNG cue channels from the feature channel) couple the causal online estimator to error magnitude: Brier beats climatology on >=3/4 domains AND corr(predicted_uncertainty,|actual_error|)>=0.40 on >=3/4 domains.
interpretation: NEGATIVE (third and final variant in the 0070-0072 budget): neither win gate fires. Brier beats climatology on 2/4 (D2 action_consequence 0.24818 vs 0.25090; D4 retrieval_usefulness 0.24769 vs 0.24839 -- both marginal; D1 0.25320 vs 0.25104 and D3 0.10292 vs 0.10173 LOSE). Coupling corr(uncertainty,|err|): 0.074/0.126/0.090/0.075 -- 0/4 reach 0.40 (best 0.126 on D2, still 3x short). corr(ehat,rest_err) diagnostic: 0.039/0.048 -- even the ehat head trained directly on the predictable component barely couples. Novelty features load-bearing on D2/D3/D4 (novelty-zeroed ablation worsens Brier); error-permutation intact<permuted on D2/D4. IMPLEMENTATION BUG (voided run, documented): the first 0072 execution ran with _extras() gating novelty features on feature_mode=='B' only, so mode C trained 7 features instead of the preregistered 11 -- the run did not match the preregistered design and was VOIDED. Fixed (one-line: mode in ('B','C')), regression unit test added (test_mode_c_includes_novelty_features), battery re-run on the same preregistered seeds. No design, feature, hyperparameter, or threshold changes were made based on observed results -- the fix restores the preregistered spec. THREE-VARIANT MECHANISM ACCOUNT: (0070) error-history features fail because changing_rule |err| is nearly temporally i.i.d. (lag-1 autocorr 0.13); (0071) prediction-time novelty features are load-bearing but tiny -- the binding constraint is irreducible cue RNG (60.5% of |err| variance; batch-oracle R^2=0.029, corr ceiling 0.17); (0072) channel decomposition (rest lag-2 autocorr 0.24) does not move coupling (0.126 vs oracle 0.17) -- the predictable remainder is dominated by fast re-learning transients and 10% reward noise flips, neither of which is visible in any causal prediction-time feature tested. CONCLUSION: the preregistered corr>=0.40 coupling target is UNREACHABLE on changing_rule's total-error as defined -- not a learning failure (the online estimator reaches ~74% of the batch-oracle ceiling on D2: 0.126 vs 0.17) but a signal ceiling. The estimator honestly beats climatology exactly where measurable signal exists (D2/D4, all three variants) and loses where it does not (D1/D3). Recommended re-scoping (future work, NOT claimed): exclude the RNG cue channels from the estimand, or use an env with less irreducible observation noise.
limitations: Single env (changing_rule), closed-loop; affect=none; PROTOTYPE replay status (not wired into act()); anchor means early ticks equal baseline (pooled prequential Brier includes transient honestly). First 0072 execution voided for implementation bug (documented above); definitive run is the second execution.
null_hypothesis: Channel decomposition adds nothing (variant C is theater too).
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_est vs Brier_climo; corr coupling gate >=0.40; ECE/MCE reported; corr(ehat,rest_err) diagnostic for D1/D3. Preregistered: experiments/preregistration_EXP-FP-0072.json (sealed pre-run). Domains/events UNCHANGED from CALIB-01.
